content.text: Tainted value flows directly from cookie through map, unsanitized into XPath query string, confirming injection.

input.justification:
User-controlled input from request.cookies.get("BenchmarkTest00019") is URL-decoded and assigned to `param`, stored in a dict and retrieved unchanged as `bar`, then directly interpolated into the XPath expression string `f'/Employees/Employee[@emplid=\'{bar}\']'` which is compiled and executed via lxml.etree.XPath(query). There is no sanitization, escaping, or validation of the value before it reaches the XPath sink (escape_for_html is only used in the error-handling branch, not on the query itself), so a crafted cookie value can inject arbitrary XPath syntax.</justification>
